description: Spec 027: the carried prior's settings, chosen on tuning seed 354 by plan.md's rule (the scale and tail whose contact-1 coverage of the carried 95% region is nearest 0.95, ties to the larger scale: scale 4, tail 1200 s, coverage 0.90; alpha stays 0.001, fall-back rate 2.3%). The tuning run itself used scale 2, tail 600, alpha 0.001 (recorded in its raw headers). Bound by digest in experiments/20261119-cp-decision/.
